Monolithisch India posts a record Q1 FY27—powered by premium products, scale-up and strong operating leverage. Q1 FY27 highlights: • Revenue: ₹47.18 cr, +64% YoY • EBITDA: ₹13.11 cr, +99% YoY • PAT: ₹10.07 cr, +135% YoY • Volume: ~52,000 MT; ~70% capacity utilisation

The key driver is the premium SGB Limited product series, which contributed ~50% of Q1 revenue and sales volume. The company says these products deliver a 15–20% longer lifespan, creating better price-to-performance for induction-furnace customers and supporting higher margins.
